budgets.note: Re-baselined in v1.53.0. The native mobile commit (78f2c6b, Capacitor 7) added an eager `import { NativeBootstrap }` in App.tsx, which pulls the Capacitor runtime into the app shell — the committed baseline is 176805 raw / 56297 gzip, already over the previous 167936/52224 ceiling before this release touched anything (the mobile commit did not update the budget). Raised to 180 KiB raw / 58 KiB gzip to fit that committed baseline plus headroom. FUTURE: NativeBootstrap no-ops on web but still bundles Capacitor into the shell — lazy/dynamic-importing it behind Capacitor.isNativePlatform() would return most of this. Prior history: re-baselined in v1.30.0 for the /klubok routes (+4 KiB raw / 1 KiB gzip).

Raw ceiling raised to 136704 in v1.51.0 (from 135168): the B2B organization surfaces added utility classes for 108 raw bytes over the old ceiling while gzip stayed at 22310, under limit. Gzip stays at 22528 and is the binding constraint — that is what crosses the network.

Raw ceiling raised to 90112 in v1.54.0: the ticketing UI (EventTickets — attendee reserve + operator management) lands in this lazy route chunk, ~2.7 KiB raw over the old 81920. Gzip is 23924, well under the 30720 ceiling and unchanged as the binding constraint.
Every admin panel is lazy-loaded per tab since v1.26.0, so this chunk is the shell only. It was 251 KB before the split, over even the old ceiling.
